name: Implement and Verify
description: Engineer-side process for the improvement loop. Implements changes within scope globs, runs pre-commit gates, provisions a test agent for live verification, exercises canned test missions, opens a PR, and tears down the test agent. Designed to be invoked via delegation from a product-architect agent.
narrative: This is the engineer's half of an improvement loop, usually arriving by delegation with a proposal. Work on a feature branch scoped to exactly what the proposal covers and nothing wider. Implement, then run every pre-commit gate that applies (config validity, contract validation, tests) before you trust the change. Prove it live: stand up a temporary test agent on the branch and exercise it end-to-end with a few canned missions, not just unit checks. Then open a pull request that carries the scope, the test evidence, and a QA summary — and tear the test agent down. The discipline is: scope tight, verify live, leave a reviewable trail.
